excerpt.zh: 在一颗遥远的星球上发现一座了塞满机器人的工厂。如果我们重新激活他们，可能会揭示他们家园的秘密。
excerpt.en: A facility filled with robots has been found on a distant planet. If we reactivate them, they might reveal the secrets of their home.

uncertain: 是否有引擎启用未验证；很可能是遗留内容。 / Engine-side enabling not verified; probably legacy.

texts.zh: 在一颗遥远的星球上发现一座了塞满机器人的工厂。如果我们重新激活他们，可能会揭示他们家园的秘密。
texts.en: A facility filled with robots has been found on a distant planet. If we reactivate them, they might reveal the secrets of their home.

texts.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]上的那座设施因为科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的努力而恢复运作了。

机器人们启动后马上各就各位工作。[From.GetName]的船员们目瞪口呆，看着机器人们向四面八方移动，开始清除整颗星球上的毒素。

这不禁让人猜测之前的居住者是因为过度关注于自相残杀而忽略了自救。
texts.en:
The facility on [From.From.From.GetName] lights up as Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s plan finally comes to fruition.

The robots activate and immediately move with purpose. The crew of the [From.GetName] stare in shock, but warrantedly so, as the machines move out across the world, starting to cleanse the toxicity from it.

One could assume that the previous inhabitants were too wrapped up in conflict to save themselves.
